# Copilot instructions

## Repository status

- This repository is currently an initial scaffold. It includes governance and
  contributor files alongside `README.md`, `.gitignore`, and `LICENSE`.
- No application source, dependency manifest, or build, test, or lint command is defined yet.
- Preserve the existing Java-oriented ignore rules in `.gitignore` unless the project technology changes.

## Working in this repository

- Read the current `README.md` and inspect the repository before introducing project structure or tooling.
- When adding the first implementation, establish the project’s build and test commands in the README and update these instructions with the canonical commands, including the command for running one test.
- Keep this file focused on repository-specific guidance; avoid adding generic programming advice.
